confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Japanese resort-town pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is least certain: July is peak season in Hakone, and budget hotels and hostels are scarce, so the dorm and 1-star figures are wide bounds. Drinks are estimated from typical Japanese bar and restaurant prices. FX came from search-result snippets citing RBA data; I could not open the RBA page directly, and the figure is for 15 October 2026, which is the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general Japanese resort and sightseeing-town pricing (Kyoto- and Nikko-type destinations) adjusted upward for Hakone's proximity to Tokyo and its resort-hotel market, with hostel and budget-hotel supply treated as limited.
